notes.subject: hemas/mashta
notes.rationale: Infinitive absolute before the verb: 'rejecting — hast thou rejected', doubling lost in Bambara

notes.subject: to Yawe
notes.rationale: The people's lament directly interrogates Yawe

notes.subject: ni (נפשך)
notes.rationale: 'Thy soul loathed' — nefesh rendered 'inner-self', closer to life-force than 'soul'

translation: Yawe, i y'i bali Yuda bali wa? Wala i ka ni Tsiyɔn kɔnɔ ju wa? Munna i y'an faga, ka sɔrɔ funuya tɛ yen an ye? An y'hɛrɛ lamini, nka n-gɛlɛn de ye; an y'funuya waati lamini, ani an bɛ yen: baisabɔ!
